metadata.cache_conditions: warm after fixture validation, activation and independent typed-cell comparison; indexed engine timing includes its own profile and integrity checks
metadata.timing_relationship: component timers are inclusive; installed profile and integrity baseline run inside the indexed elapsed timer; no separate hash-only or quick_check timing pass
metadata.fixture_authority: controlled offline test fixtures; byte hashing is a cost comparison, not validation or a proposed trust boundary

method.comparison: same canonical retained cells; v2 full semantics vs v4 normal engine vs v4 full audit
method.baseline: both engines share grouping and compiled schema helpers, but v4 freshly checks every binding while v2 checks full binding schemas through retained payload semantics; historical v1 metadata-only and old schema-construction timings are separate
method.timed_scope: protected coherent read transaction; locks/open/setup/upgrade/activation excluded; profile+baseline+semantic work included
method.timers: inclusive component timers; do not sum them; returned facts are cross-checked against observed semantic calls and independent typed-cell coverage
method.coverage: source-volume counters cover original retained typed cells; index metadata and installed-profile reads are additional work included in elapsed time, not a measured total physical IO volume
method.cache: warm after fixture full validation, explicit activation and independent retained-byte comparison; no cold-cache claim
method.authority: controlled offline fixtures; no live GitHub, candidate execution, dispatch, task closure or authority granted by benchmark digests
method.repetitions: one per workload by default; elapsed results are diagnostic, not machine-dependent acceptance thresholds
method.growth: normal checks still read all retained bytes, recheck global structure and fresh binding schemas; storage/latency are not bounded
